basic_info.description: Welcome to a stunning blend of timeless San Francisco charm and modern sophistication in the heart of the Parkside neighborhood. Step inside to admire the original hardwood floors, meticulously refinished with a clear coat. The spacious barrel-fronted living room is flooded with natural light, with its contemporary mantle serving as a striking focal point. The home’s classic architecture is seamlessly complemented with designer finishes. The formal dining area flows effortlessly into a European-inspired kitchen, a chef's delight. With sleek two-tone white and wood cabinetry, premium Bosch appliances, & quartz countertops. Upstairs, you’ll find two generously sized bedrooms, including a luxurious primary suite complete with a walk-in closet/powder room and private deck access. Step out onto the deck to enjoy breathtaking views and overlook the lush backyard. Convenience is elevated with an upstairs laundry facility thoughtfully included. The lower level, accessible via a separate entrance, offers exceptional versatility. This space features a secondary suite, a half bath, full wet bar, a dedicated laundry facility, and direct access to the spacious backyard/ patio. Just steps away from Taraval, where you can find Shopping, dining, and Muni access. Don't miss out!
